title: Nidorina #30 Topps Pokemon TV Animation Edition 1999 Trading Card Series 1
descriptionText:
#30 Nidorina
1999 Topps Pokémon, TV Animation Edition Series 1
Base card — the standard non-foil printing
Black Topps logo printing
Type: Poison. The second stage of the female Nidoran line
Officially licensed by Nintendo; a Topps trading card, not a Pokémon TCG game card
Condition: Very good. The top-left corner is dinged with visible whitening — there is a close-up photo of it so you can judge it yourself before buying. Otherwise sound: no creases, no bends, no writing, and the printed surface is clean. Priced for the flaw.
